industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Narrow market breadth persists with only 11 of 144 groups all-green, led by sustained strength in Oil & Gas Refining and Marine Shipping alongside an aggressive push into Diagnostics & Research, while mining, metals, and alternative energy face sharp multi-session selloffs.

Market leadership remains tightly concentrated. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.983, rank 2) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.953, rank 4) continue to anchor broad-timeframe strength, complemented by steady bids across healthcare and defensive financials like Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.841). Concurrently, capital is rotating toward select retail and healthcare groups, with Diagnostics & Research surging +26 spots to rank 46 and Consumer Electronics advancing +13 spots into rank 28.

Conversely, basic materials and commodities are rolling over rapidly. Coking Coal plunged -45 spots to rank 89, joined by sharp breakdowns in Uranium (-32 spots), Other Precious Metals & Mining (-31 spots), and Aluminum (-29 spots). At the bottom, clean energy continues to lag heavily, with Utilities - Renewable dropping -16 spots and Solar scraping the baseline as the weakest group across industries with a 0.080 momentum score.

* **Broad-Timeframe Anchors:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.983 momentum, rank 2) and Marine Shipping (0.953 momentum, rank 4) pace the 11 all-green groups with sustained top-36 positioning across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
* **Healthcare & Financial Resilience:** Diagnostics & Research (0.892 momentum), Insurance - Reinsurance (0.841 momentum), Financial Conglomerates (0.83 momentum), and Health Information Services (0.82 momentum) all exhibit all-green breadth and sustained high-rank consistency.
* **Tech & Infrastructure Foothold:** Consumer Electronics (0.913 momentum) holds all-green status, while Software - Infrastructure maintains sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month rankings.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top 5-Day Gainers:** Diagnostics & Research gained +26 spots (rank 46, momentum 0.89), Publishing surged +19 spots (rank 45, momentum 0.74), while Department Stores (+15 spots to rank 83) and Grocery Stores (+15 spots to rank 104) saw sharp rank improvements.
* **Severe 5-Day Drops:** Commodity-tied groups cratered, led by Coking Coal (-45 spots to rank 89, momentum 0.48), Uranium (-32 spots to rank 101, momentum 0.17), and Other Precious Metals & Mining (-31 spots to rank 102, momentum 0.40).
* **Momentum Extremes:** Top-ranked momentum resides in Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.983) and Marine Shipping (0.953), while the absolute weakest momentum sits with Solar (0.080, rank 138), Footwear & Accessories (0.087, rank 141), and Utilities - Independent Power Producers (0.097, rank 137).

## Divergences
* **Fading Leadership:** Despite solid momentum readings, short-term rank declines signal exhaustion in Gold (momentum 0.62, rank -11 in 5d), Biotechnology (momentum 0.73, rank -6 in 5d), Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.68, rank -6 in 5d), Copper (momentum 0.67, rank -5 in 5d), and Banks - Regional (momentum 0.62, rank -4 in 5d).
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Rapid 5-day rank advances outpace still-depressed momentum scores in Grocery Stores (rank +15, momentum 0.47), Aerospace & Defense (rank +10, momentum 0.37), Luxury Goods (rank +10, momentum 0.40), Discount Stores (rank +8, momentum 0.42), and Real Estate - Diversified (rank +8, momentum 0.43).
